avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces efavirenz plasma concentrations by 25-50%, leading to subtherapeutic levels and viral resistance
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently. Counsel patient to avoid all herbal products containing St. John's Wort

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce efavirenz concentrations and antiviral efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose garlic supplements; monitor viral load if used. Recommend food sources of garlic instead

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampicin-containing supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4/2B6 inducer significantly decreases efavirenz concentrations below therapeutic levels
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; use alternative antimycobacterial therapy or efavirenz dosage adjustment with close monitoring

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin E (high-dose >400 IU/day)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive effects on CNS; efavirenz commonly causes dizziness and neuropsychiatric effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased CNS symptoms; maintain moderate supplementation if needed

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 induction may slightly reduce efavirenz levels
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor viral load if high-dose supplementation is continued

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals (>50g fat)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Increases efavirenz absorption and peak concentrations, potentially exacerbating CNS adverse effects (dizziness, impaired concentration, vivid dreams)
avoid_foods.action: Take efavirenz on empty stomach or with low-fat meal; avoid heavy fatty meals, especially around dosing time

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase efavirenz concentrations and adverse effects
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; monitor for increased CNS side effects if grapefruit intake increases

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; efavirenz frequently causes dizziness, impaired concentration, and psychiatric effects
caution_foods.action: Minimize alcohol consumption; counsel on additive neuropsychiatric risks and impaired judgment/driving

monitoring_notes: Monitor for CNS adverse effects (dizziness, impaired concentration, vivid dreams, psychiatric symptoms) which are dose- and administration-dependent. Ensure adherence to empty stomach administration recommendations and counsel against high-fat meals to minimize absorption variability and toxicity risk.
